headline: Indian Corporate Capex Remains Constrained Despite Strong Investment-to-GDP Ratio
summary: Corporate capital expenditure across India faces headwinds from global policy flux and government capex patterns, even as the country's total investment-to-GDP ratio remains above pre-pandemic levels.
why: Private capex recovery is critical for sustaining India's long-term GDP growth and domestic infrastructure development.

impacts.name: Indian Industrial Capex
impacts.why: High economy-wide investment ratios are offset by private corporate caution amidst global uncertainty.
